lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Mn2O6 (reduced formula K2MnO3) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a 12-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while K centers have 12 geometric neighbors (6 K, 6 O), and O centers have three Mn neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and face-sharing between K 12-vertex polyhedra and Mn octahedra are observed; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
